items.headline: Jon Sumrall, Auburn top trolls from Week 7 in college football
items.description: After the upset, Sumrall was in a celebratory mood, donning a cowboy hat fit for a Texan while striding through the hallways of Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium.

items.headline: Garrison Rippa nails go-ahead field goal to help Jacksonville State edge FIU 27-24
items.description: — Caden Creel threw for 214 yards and two touchdowns, and Garrison Rippa kicked a 26-yard field goal with 44 seconds remaining as Jacksonville State edged FIU 27-24 on Tuesday night.

items.headline: Garrison Rippa makes field goal with 51 seconds left as Jacksonville State tops Kennesaw State 27-26
items.description: — Garrison Rippa made a go-ahead field goal in the final minute, and Rob Billings IV intercepted a pass seconds later as Jacksonville State beat Kennesaw State 27-26 on Wednesday night in a rematch of the 2025 Conference USA championship game.
